title: Balance Sheet Audit Trail
summary: Traces every line on the Statement of Financial Position back to its supporting Trial Balance accounts and General Ledger transactions, flagging anything that doesn't reconcile. Data can come from an Excel upload (SOFP/TB/GL) or a direct read-only pull from the connected staging Odoo instance for a chosen date range.
prompt: in addition to uploading SOFP, TB and GL as Excel files, also add an option pull that data directly from Odoo.
assumptions: The Excel upload path, its expected file layout, and the reconciliation logic are unchanged from the previous version.

'Pull from Odoo' reads the standard Accounting module records (account.move, account.move.line, account.account) on the staging instance already connected to this tool via environment variables — not a custom module.
Only posted (validated) Odoo journal entries are included; draft/unposted entries are excluded, matching a finalized Excel export.
One company, one period per Odoo pull; no multi-company consolidation and no period-over-period comparison in a single run.
The Odoo pull is read-only: nothing is written back to Odoo.

Odoo doesn't export a formatted Statement of Financial Position, so SOFP 'lines' pulled from Odoo are built by grouping account balances under Odoo's own account_type categories (e.g. Cash and Cash Equivalents, Trade and Other Payables) rather than reproducing your organization's exact statement captions.
Uploaded workbooks and pulled Odoo data live only in server memory for the running process; restarting the app clears all sessions, and nothing from Odoo is cached between runs.
gaps: If ODOO_URL/ODOO_DB/ODOO_USERNAME/ODOO_API_KEY aren't set on the server, the 'Pull from Odoo' option will report a clear configuration error and only the Excel upload path will work.
Note-linked disclosures (separate note sheets referenced by a Note column) are not cross-referenced automatically for either source.
Sign-convention differences between systems are flagged as a likely mismatch rather than silently corrected.
expects: Either: the three Excel sheets (.xlsx/.xlsm) — Statement of Financial Position (SOFP), Trial Balance (TB) and General Ledger (GL) — in the same layout the tool already expects

Or: a start and end date for a period to pull directly from the connected staging Odoo instance (requires ODOO_URL/ODOO_DB/ODOO_USERNAME/ODOO_API_KEY to be set on the server; no credentials are entered in the browser)

history.prompt: Create a generic Balance Sheet Audit Support feature that accepts an uploaded Excel workbook (following the same structure as the provided sample workbook) as input. The workbook will contain at least three sheets: "SOFP", "TB New 2025", and "GL New 2025" (or equivalent configurable sheet names). The feature should automatically read the workbook, identify the Statement of Financial Position (SOFP), Trial Balance (TB), and General Ledger (GL) data, and generate an end-to-end audit trail for every Balance Sheet head. For each SOFP closing balance, identify the relevant TB and GL account(s), derive the closing balance from the underlying GL data, present a detailed breakup showing how the reported balance is composed, reconcile the aggregated GL balance with the reported SOFP balance, and clearly flag any differences, missing mappings, or unreconciled amounts. The output should be a structured audit report that enables Finance and Audit teams to trace every reported Balance Sheet figure back to its supporting ledger accounts and transactions without manually reviewing the entire General Ledger. The implementation should work for any uploaded workbook that follows the same tabular structure as the sample, rather than being hardcoded to a specific file.
